integrity: Exact finite exhaustive orbit and signed simplicial enumerations agree. Independent mod-two chain ranks match the known homology Betti numbers; published integer homology concentration is cited rather than reproved. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite full tetrahedron only; no integral representation-lattice decomposition, no higher-dimensional extrapolation or equivariant homotopy equivalence; originality may be affected by unindexed sources.
title: The full symmetric-group character of the tetrahedral discrete-Morse complex
